verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hosted AI runtime like LocalAI, but the evidence pack never documents any telemetry setting or opt-out control. The only 'usage tracking' mention describes a per-user tracking feature turned on with LOCALAI_AUTH=true. That is an adjacent multi-user accounting capability, not a way to opt out of vendor telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
